_about: Guest-facing copy. Keys are looked up in the invitation's variant first, then in base. Keys starting with '_' are variant metadata, not text. Adding a variant (e.g. hindu, buddha) is data only: add it here and to variantsOrder. Religious greetings are marked for review by someone of that faith (see MARKETFIT-REPORT.md). Scripture text lives in scripture.json, never here.
